defects.title: GitHub Actions cannot start jobs for the exact candidate
defects.impact: Exact-head CI, security, CodeQL, and review gates cannot execute, so the candidate cannot be promoted.
defects.remediation: Restore GitHub Actions execution at the organization billing or spending-control boundary, then create fresh runs for the current candidate SHA.

defects.title: package-lock.json is not synchronized with package.json

evidence.firstError: npm ci can only install packages when package.json and package-lock.json are in sync

defects.impact: Locked dependency installation fails before tests, audit, typecheck, or builds run.
defects.remediation: Regenerate package-lock.json only with the repository Node 22 and npm 11 toolchain, then prove npm ci succeeds.

defects.title: Initial Node pin is below a locked production dependency engine minimum
defects.impact: The candidate's declared runtime does not satisfy its locked dependency graph.
defects.remediation: Pin a supported Node 22 LTS patch and rerun the locked install and full verification suite.
